title: ClusterAttention: A training-free speedup of bidirectional attention
abstract: arXiv:2608.26965v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper introduces ClusterAttention, a general training-free speedup of bidirectional attention layers. Existing sparse attention methods either rely on structure in the input, such as order in language or spatial proximity in images, or use slow clustering processes amortized over several forward passes. ClusterAttention instead uses a fast recursive clustering method that adapts to the geometry of the keys and queries in each attention head to produce useful clusters. This method allows setting the size of the clusters arbitrarily. We utilize this by setting all clusters to be a fixed size that is a power of two, allowing the block-sparse attention to run at the same latency per query-key interaction as dense attention on GPUs. We also derive an expression for the output error in sparse attention, that explains the counterintuitive experimental finding that tight clusters can lead to larger errors than random clusters. translated_title: ClusterAttention：一种无需训练的双向注意力加速方法
translated_abstract: 本文介绍了ClusterAttention，一种通用的、无需训练的双向注意力层加速方法。现有的稀疏注意力方法要么依赖于输入的结构（如语言中的顺序或图像中的空间邻近性），要么使用缓慢的聚类过程并在多次前向传播中摊销。ClusterAttention采用了一种快速递归聚类方法，该方法适应每个注意力头中键和查询的几何结构，以生成有用的聚类。这种方法允许任意设置聚类的大小。我们利用这一特性，将所有聚类设置为固定大小（2的幂），使得块稀疏注意力在GPU上每个查询-键交互的延迟与密集注意力相同。我们还推导了稀疏注意力中输出误差的表达式，这解释了反直觉的实验发现：紧密聚类可能比随机聚类导致更大的误差。然后我们推导出...
tldr: 本文提出了一种无需训练的快速递归聚类方法，通过自适应键和查询的几何结构生成固定大小的聚类，在GPU上实现与密集注意力相同延迟的稀疏注意力加速，并推导出误差表达式解释了紧密聚类可能优于随机聚类的反直觉现象。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a training-free fast recursive clustering method that adapts to key-query geometry to generate fixed-size clusters, achieving dense-attention-equivalent latency on GPUs for sparse attention, and derives an error expression explaining the counterintuitive finding that tight clusters may outperform random ones.
